validation: Freeze the category mix selected on train; compare twice per case against baseline. Validation may reject a category change before final freeze.
heldout: Only after final freeze compare test baseline versus frozen candidate, twice per case; do not retune on test.
tokens: Unified 5,000,000 ceiling includes workflow and later cascade/grounding calls.
text_value_scope: production question and field-crop image protocol; not an executed runtime receipt
